articles.title: Data center electricity use could double by 2030, IEA says
articles.description: Global electricity use by data centers could double by 2030 as the AI boom adds pressure to power grids across the world, according to the IEA.

articles.title: North Korean hackers used Sky's stablecoin system, putting billions at freeze risk
articles.description: Blockchain investigation traced $518 million in illicit-linked activity, including the 2025 Bybit hack, through a key reserve backing DAI and USDS tokens, putting Sky's institutional finance ambitions and open design on collision course.

articles.title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
articles.description: Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.

articles.title: GameStop CEO Says Digital-Only Games Have ‘Hurt Consumers’ as GTA 6 Skips Discs
articles.description: Ryan Cohen said publishers are cutting out trade-ins, as he backs a U.S. bill that would guarantee gamers keep access to games they buy.

articles.title: Anthropic’s $107 billion sale set to top SpaceX’s IPO as tokenized stocks gain traction
articles.description: The maker of Claude priced its Nasdaq debut at $83 a share for a $1.5 trillion fully diluted valuation, with the Nasdaq 100 down 14% from record highs.

articles.title: ‘Highly advanced’ quantum computers could crack financial encryption in five years
articles.description: No quantum computer can yet break widely used cryptography, but the securities watchdog says banks and blockchains face a yearslong security overhaul that many have barely begun.

articles.title: APEC final day in photos: Trump, Xi and Putin shake hands; Takaichi kept at a distance
articles.description: Leaders gathered Thursday for the second day of the economic summit, ahead of a historic trilateral meeting between the U.S., Russia and China.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin nears $64,000 as Anthropic’s record IPO lifts tech
articles.description: Nasdaq futures jumped nearly 2% with Anthropic shares indicated as much as 24% higher, and one analyst said IPO money could flow back into crypto.

articles.title: Denmark ratifies Trump security deal over Greenland after months of diplomatic tensions
articles.description: It follows months of tensions after President Donald Trump repeatedly said the U.S. should take control of Greenland for national security reasons.

articles.title: Singapore settles $77.5 million tokenized bill sale in local CBDC
articles.description: The central bank aims to expand this digital settlement network and test wider collateral use in 2027.

articles.title: Trump says U.S., China, Russia ‘uniquely positioned’ to discuss reducing nuclear weapons at historic meeting
articles.description: The leaders of the U.S., China and Russia met in Shenzhen on Thursday for a rare trilateral gathering.

articles.title: IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps
articles.description: A Solana test network ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures, and wallets that keep using older keys could remain vulnerable.

articles.title: Bitcoin Struggles to Hold $64,000 as ETF Outflows Hit $2.9B in November
articles.description: Bitcoin is down 13% in a week as investors pull money from spot ETFs and brace for another Federal Reserve rate hike.

articles.title: Roundhill scraps Solana and XRP income ETFs as rival funds indicate low demand
articles.description: Roundhill withdrew plans for two funds designed to generate income from SOL and XRP, highlighting the gap between billions invested in spot crypto ETFs and limited demand for more specialized strategies.

articles.title: Novartis raises blockbuster drug forecasts to $18 billion as it seeks to prove growth can last
articles.description: The drugmaker cited strong demand for its blockbuster drugs as it upgraded peak sales forecasts for multiple sclerosis, leukemia, and cholesterol medicines.

articles.title: Trump praises ‘great relationship’ with Putin after meeting, as Ukraine war takes center stage
articles.description: U.S. President Donald Trump met individually on Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin, as well as Chinese President Xi Jinping.

articles.title: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
articles.description: MAS issued the bills directly on its test network, which it plans to rename SG Digital Ledger and use for settlement beyond the trials.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $306.4 million Wednesday, pushing their combined assets to $77.7 billion as Bitcoin briefly traded below $63,000.

articles.title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
articles.description: The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.

articles.title: Bitcoin retests $62K as Nasdaq futures rise ahead of Anthropic debut
articles.description: Bitcoin climbed back above $63,500 after its second dip to $62,000 this week, while Anthropic priced its record $81.3 billion IPO at $83 a share.
